name: taskflow-kanban
description: Kanban full stack (React + Express + SQLite) com validação, tratamento global de erros e testes
author: augustoemiliano

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
